issues.quote: Revenue rose to $574.8 million in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: The unit is wrong. Amazon's fiscal 2023 revenue was $574.8 billion, not million. As written, the sentence also compares millions to billions.

data.summary: The analysis has one error: it puts fiscal 2023 revenue at $574.8 million when the correct figure is $574.8 billion. All the other figures match Amazon's reported results: 11.8% revenue growth, net income of $30.4B against a $2.7B loss the year before, operating cash flow of $84.9B against $46.8B, cash of $73.4B against $53.9B, total assets of $527.9B against $462.7B, and total liabilities of $326.0B against $316.6B.
